389 likes, 37 comments - budgetbytes on October 21, 2026: "These Smothered Pork Chops are a Southern staple that comes together in one skillet in 35 minutes! The chops get a light flour coating and a hard sear, then rest on a plate while you build the savory onion gravy in the same pan. Serve it over mashed potatoes, rice, or cheese grits so none of it goes to waste! 🙌
